verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: There is no scientific evidence that drinking hot water with lemon juice can prevent, treat, or cure COVID-19. Health organizations and medical experts have widely debunked this claim.
verdicts.reasoning_en: An overwhelming number of TIER_1 fact-checking organizations, including FactCheck.org, Politifact, AFP, AP News, Snopes, and FACTLY, have independently investigated and debunked the claim that drinking hot water with lemon can destroy the coronavirus. These sources consistently state that there is no scientific evidence to support this assertion, and health officials have refuted it. The claim is a widely circulated piece of health misinformation from the COVID-19 pandemic.
